Assignments.m0_description: QualiAdept platform onboarding module. Test the Monaco code editor, verify automated assertions in real-time, and submit your first HTML layout to become familiar with the automated validation workflow before starting the course.
Assignments.m1_description: Build the HTML structure (Boilerplate) with semantic tags and data-testid attributes for the Task Tracker.
Assignments.m2_description: Transform the Task Tracker skeleton into a structured application with an external CSS stylesheet, flexible navbar, structured table rows, and dynamic buttons with disabled states.
Assignments.m3_description: Variables, data types, and Arrow Functions.
Assignments.m4_description: Event listeners (addEventListener) and adding elements to the DOM.
Assignments.m5_description: The Event Loop concept. Client-server communication using the Fetch API.
Assignments.m6_description: Finalize the Kanban board logic. This application will be the subject of our E2E automated test suites.
Assignments.m7_description: Static typing, primitives, any, void, and tsconfig.json configuration.
Assignments.m8_description: Advanced structures in TypeScript. Refactor code using Interfaces and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
Assignments.m9_description: Configuring playwright.config.ts and generating your first automated test via Playwright CLI.
Assignments.m10_description: Write core browser interactions: page.goto, fill, click, and select.
Assignments.m11_description: Avoid brittle selectors. Master getByRole, getByText, and getByTestId locators.
Assignments.m12_description: Handle state validation using Playwright 'expect'. Assert visibility, text content, and element state.
Assignments.m13_description: Framework architecture for enterprise scalability. Build reusable page classes in TypeScript.
Assignments.m14_description: Create custom fixtures and execute parameterized data-driven test suites from JSON.
Assignments.m15_description: Persist session storageState for one-time rapid authenticated test runs.
Assignments.m16_description: Network interception. Test UI error resilience by simulating HTTP 500 backend responses.
Assignments.m17_description: Configure Playwright Trace Viewer, video capture on failure, and automated retries for flaky tests.
Assignments.m18_description: Write automated CI/CD pipelines. YAML workflow syntax and triggers (on: push).
Assignments.m19_description: Run automated headless test suites in Ubuntu containers and validate continuous integration.
Assignments.m20_title: Session 20: Final Demo Day & Certification Review
Assignments.m20_description: Execute the final comprehensive test suite and attain 100% score for official certification.
